notes: Default 'realistic customer' role profile. The host evaluation-expert agent loads system_prompt.md, expands placeholders ({{customer_persona}} / {{goal}} / {{stop_conditions}} / {{context}} / {{current_emotion}} / {{dialog_so_far}} / {{effective_max_turns}}) from enriched_test_case + execution_trace_so_far, then asks its OWN LLM to produce a SimulatorDecision. The agent forwards decision.next_utterance to runtime_driver.send and appends the decision to execution_trace.simulator_trail. There is intentionally NO entry script and NO model/api_key configuration — this profile does not run as a subprocess and does not call any external LLM.
